commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

43' 1 - 0 Goal! Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

43' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Emiliano Martinez shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
40' Half-chance! Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) plays a pass into the box, but Emiliano Martinez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
38' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

35' What a huge chance for Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

34' Great solo effort from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
34' Aston Villa hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
31' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

29' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
28' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes it short.
26' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
25' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.

14' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

13' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
11' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Emiliano Martinez makes a save.

8' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
7' Emiliano Martinez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) after a cross from the side.
6' Bernd Leno leaps to intercept the corner kick from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
